critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py L1502 - TMS pagination math uses (total or len(rows)) which double-counts when interco deal expansion produces 2 rows per deal: 'total' from _get_deals_for_report is deal count but 'rows' is post-expansion. Pages calc inconsistent for interco-heavy result sets. Consider returning 'total_rows' (expanded) alongside 'total' (deals) for clarity, or paginate AFTER expansion.

backend/server.py L1519-1524 - TMS PDF branch only runs if rpt.tms_pdf exists; if not, server returns CSV with format=pdf request silently. Should raise 400 if PDF requested but generator missing, or build a pdf via reportlab on the fly.

backend/server.py L1177 - Settlement query is {'$or': [{status: confirmed}, {status: pending}]}; cancelled/expired deals never appear which is intentional, but combined with date_from/date_to merged via setdefault('value_date',{}) the $or + value_date filter both apply only to the *outer* doc and value_date filter is fine but the constructed query mutates a shared dict reference (deepcopy not used) — fine here because dict() shallow copy is taken before _get_deals_for_report, but worth a comment.

backend/server.py L1488 - date_submitted slices created_at[:19].replace('T',' ') without timezone handling. For SAP TMS uploads the timezone (UTC) is significant; consider explicit 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS UTC' or keep ISO.

backend/server.py L1492-1496 - Interco dual-line generation duplicates _all_ fields including amount, rate, currencies. For SAP TMS, line .1 (Sell) typically uses sell_currency/sell_fx_amt and line .2 (Buy) uses buy_currency/buy_fx_amt as the primary leg. Currently both lines carry identical amount columns which may not match SAP mass-upload expectations. Confirm with business whether amounts should be swapped or zeroed on the opposite leg.

backend/server.py L944-948 - Counterparty seeding only runs when count == 0. If an admin deletes all counterparties intentionally the next startup will reseed unexpectedly. Use a version flag (like the transaction_types reseed at L926) or check a 'seeded' marker.

frontend NewDealPage.jsx L257 vs L284 - both Source and Destination render the same SearchSelect bound to f.counterparty (single state). For FX-Intercompany the destination counterparty dropdown writes to the same field as source, so selecting on the To side overwrites the From side. Confirm intentional (single counterparty per Interco deal) — if not, model needs a second field (to_counterparty).
